purpose: Preserve and coordinate multiple lawful rehydration branches under explicit width/depth/branch budgets without pretending that campaign branches are background workers or merge authority.
authority_ceiling: coordination only; below branch protection, merge, release, source mutation, evidence promotion, and user authority

composition.campaign_state: Git-persisted append-only event chain plus current branch projection

freshness.start: expected_git_head must equal the observed current Git head after the configured shared-frontier sync
freshness.mutation: expected campaign checkpoint must remain the current campaign-state commit and an ancestor of the current work head
freshness.qualification: the campaign implementation branch must rehydrate the current master frontier before any exact-head CI result can qualify merge

operations.start: create one bounded campaign graph from an exact Git head
operations.claim: assign a logical-clock lease to one branch
operations.release: return a claimed branch to OPEN
operations.bind_loop: bind a claimed branch to an exact V1 loop state/checkpoint
operations.sync_branch: project the bound loop state into campaign branch state
operations.expand: materialize SELECTED or AMBIGUOUS successor baton candidates as child branches subject to budgets
operations.reconcile: record an observed selection among WITNESSED branches; supersession is explicit, never inferred from omission
operations.resume: return the full current branch frontier and campaign state
operations.verify: verify event-chain, topology, branch-budget, depth and width invariants

expansion.AMBIGUOUS: one child per retained tie unless caller supplies selected_candidate_ids

lease_model.purpose: prevent duplicate branch ownership without depending on wall-clock truth
lease_model.law: CLAIMED_BRANCH != ACTIVE_WORKER; work exists only when an explicit agent executes it

reconciliation.eligible: only WITNESSED branches may become ACCEPTED
reconciliation.supersede_branch_ids: only explicitly named WITNESSED/BLOCKED branches become SUPERSEDED; unrelated branches remain unchanged
reconciliation.terminal_result: COMPLETE only with observed integration_witness.git_head equal to the current observed Git head and no unresolved active frontier
reconciliation.law: RECONCILED != GIT_MERGED unless an external Git integration witness is supplied

promotion_hold.condition: before MCP promotion, V1 loop substantive-work accounting must exclude sibling rehydration/campaign coordination-only commits so control-plane writes cannot satisfy a work-progress gate by themselves

laws: AMBIGUITY MAY EXPAND INTO BOUNDED BRANCHES
CAMPAIGN COMPLETE REQUIRES OBSERVED INTEGRATION WITNESS
